summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (IPNS Signature-Verify Coverage) end-to-end via the GSD pipeline, then ship it through the full post-execution loop: verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit CLI review, PR creation, and review resolution.
summary.outcome: Phase 58 was fully planned (4 plans, 2 waves), executed (4/4 complete), and verified (7/7 must-haves, all D-01..D-13 decisions confirmed in code). The ship pipeline completed gates 1–6 (verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E 89/89, CodeRabbit CLI 5 findings triaged) and was mid-application of CodeRabbit fixes before the transcript ends; the PR had not yet been pushed.

repo: Phase 58 was the last phase in the v1.1-hardening milestone; STATE.md was set to 'Milestone complete' on completion.

The SDK E2E secret is TEST_LOGIN_SECRET from apps/api/.env (value: e2e-test-secret-ci-only); vitest 3 does NOT auto-load tests/sdk-e2e/.env, so the env var must be passed explicitly as SDK_E2E_SECRET.
A secret mismatch causes the entire SDK E2E suite to silently 401 and skip — it reports 0 failures, not an error, so it's indistinguishable from a passing run without checking skip counts.
crates/fuse cannot dev-depend on api-client or core (circular dependency), so cross-language vector test consumers go in crates/fuse/tests/ not crates/crypto/tests/.
commit_failed from the GSD commit helper is a known false-negative — always verify with 'git log --oneline -1' rather than retrying.
6 unverified resolve_ipns call sites remain in apps/desktop/src-tauri/ (prepopulate.rs, vault.rs) — explicitly deferred in 58-01, no regression from baseline.
REQUIREMENTS.md traceability table is missing 5 REQ-IDs: IPNS-05/06, DB-01/02, BYO-08 — pre-existing hygiene debt unrelated to HARD-09.
github-actions[bot] pushes a chore(release) commit to the branch after 'gh pr create' and after a passing Release Preview — git fetch + rebase required before the next push or it will be rejected.
gh pr edit fails on this repo due to Projects-classic GraphQL; PR body must be patched via 'env -u GITHUB_TOKEN gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file'.
markdownlint excludes .planning/ but prettier still runs there.
git push / git fetch are blocked in the sandbox — must run with sandbox disabled.
CodeRabbit bundles findings in both the review body AND inline review threads; /resolve-pr-reviews may find 0 threads if only the body is checked.

code.finding: Missing explicit existence check on cborFields['Sequence'] before BigInt coercion — should guard with a clear binding-mismatch error when the field is absent (CodeRabbit minor finding).

btoa(String.fromCharCode(...cbor)) used for base64 encoding — CodeRabbit flagged it as potentially corrupting bytes >127. Technically valid for 0-255 but Buffer.from(cbor).toString('base64') is the idiomatic Node.js form and silences the finding.
Missing unit tests for two edge cases: u64 sequence overflow (should return error, not wrap) and invalid-UTF-8 CBOR Value rejection. These are genuine coverage gaps flagged by CodeRabbit.
Uses unchecked 'seq + 1' for sequence increment — the crate convention is checked_add to avoid silent wrapping on u64 overflow (code review finding WR-01, applied during phase).

workflow: Sequential execution on the feature branch (not parallel worktrees) is the safer choice for multi-crate crypto phases — avoids cwd-drift, merge failures, and stranded worktrees.
Running the security audit and simplify review in parallel during the ship pipeline saves significant wall-clock time since both are read-only analysis of the same diff.

GSD executor commits may use a non-conventional 'feat 51-03:' style that fails pr-release-preview CI; reword with 'git filter-branch --msg-filter' (not git rebase -i, which is unavailable in this environment) before the first push.

The plan checker will flag RESEARCH.md 'Open Questions' sections that lack a '(RESOLVED)' marker even when all questions are substantively answered in-plan — a cosmetic fix avoids a false verification warning.
Phase verifier confirms decisions in code (not just SUMMARY claims), which is more reliable than trusting executor self-reports — use it to validate executor accuracy, not just as a formality.

An executor spawned for plan N may continue into plan N+1 if plans are logically adjacent and auto-mode is on — harmless in sequential execution but means plan-boundary tracking must come from git log, not the executor's return message.

The full SDK E2E recipe (pnpm chain rebuild + fresh API start + correct secrets) must be run explicitly; the executor's 'infra-limited' skip label is a misclassification when the real issue is a secret mismatch.

CodeRabbit CLI review ('coderabbit review --agent --base main --type committed') takes 5-15 min and blocks the ship pipeline — kick it off as early as possible and work on other pre-push steps in parallel.

friction: 58-01 executor crashed mid-task due to an API socket close after committing 3 of 5 tasks, leaving uncommitted FUSE routing changes and no SUMMARY.md — required a manual continuation agent.
SDK E2E gate was initially misclassified as 'infra-limited' by the executor due to TEST_LOGIN_SECRET mismatch; the entire suite silently skipped (0 failures, not an error), masking the gap.
One executor spawned for 58-02 also completed 58-03 without being asked — plan-boundary enforcement was not respected.
The commit helper's false-negative 'commit_failed' response created unnecessary uncertainty at multiple points in the pipeline.
RESEARCH.md's '## Open Questions' heading lacking '(RESOLVED)' triggered a plan-checker warning and required a manual doc edit to clear.
Fix commits applied by the code-fixer had mislabeled scopes (e.g., fix(58-03) touching a 58-01 file) — cosmetically wrong, though functionally correct.
CodeRabbit CLI review is a synchronous 5-15 min blocking step mid-pipeline with no progress indicator.
The 'phase uat-passed' CLI command appears in help output but has no handler — a pre-existing dead stub that can cause confusion.
